entries.zh: 过去（走过、经过；往彼处而去）
entries.en: to pass by going; go past, go away

entries.zh: 过来（走过来；往此处而来）
entries.en: to pass coming; come over, come along

entries.zh: 蹽田洋（蹚行走过田洋；首字疑为"蹽"）
entries.en: to wade/walk across the fields and plains (driving the herd through)
entries.notes: 汉字首字[疑:廖/蹽]，西语短语（vaca/veda/cemera）转写含混；释义取 H/M 对合之"蹽（蹚行）过田洋"义

entries.zh: 蹽水过去（蹚水而过）
entries.en: to wade across the water
entries.notes: 汉字首字[疑:廖/蹽]；"蹽水"与西语"pasar el agua a nadar"（涉水而渡）义合

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: Manuscript smudged; gloss uncertain
entries.notes: 首音节调标 T99 污损难辨，西语"como das"转写含混；汉字"波累"或为牵连拖累义，未能与四栏互证定夺

entries.zh: 步位大（晋升至高位；据西语推断）
entries.en: to rise to higher rank or dignity
entries.notes: 第二音节调标 T99 污损难辨（"位"字或为他字），释义主要依西语"pasar a mayor dignidad"推断

entries.zh: 步辇（人力抬挽之舆；西语对文作"步行"义，字形[疑:輦/軨]）
entries.en: hand-carried litter; per the Spanish gloss, to go on foot
entries.notes: 字形[疑:輦/軨]；"步辇"本义为步挽之车，与西语"pasar a pie"（步行）义项错位，对合存疑

entries.zh: 过往（往来通行；自一处至另一处）
entries.en: to pass from one place to another; go to and fro

entries.zh: 更筹（古代计更报时之筹签；谓更漏时辰流逝）
entries.en: night-watch tallies; the passing of the hours (water-clock)

entries.zh: 过关（越关转赴另一管辖；首二字疑作"關羽"，或为"關羽過關"之对写）
entries.en: to pass over to another jurisdiction; cross a frontier pass
entries.notes: 首字[疑:闋/關]；对音 cuán vǔ 近"關羽"，与西语"otra jurisdiccion"（另辖）义对合曲折

entries.zh: 过日（度日、过日子；消磨时日）
entries.en: to pass the days, get by; live on in pastimes

entries.zh: 进步（前进；在功名品级上更进一步）
entries.en: to advance, make progress; move up in attainment or rank

entries.zh: 先行（先行、走在前头；M 栏另记后两音节，未确证）
entries.en: to go first, go ahead
entries.notes: M 栏第二词 "lōey quīa" 音节未确证（或为同族"行"类词），据首词"先行"与西语释义取义

entries.zh: 过头（行过、越过；谓往其所到之处）
entries.en: to go past; pass on to where one is going

entries.zh: 转过（转递、辗转递过）
entries.en: to pass along, hand on from hand to hand

entries.zh: 转手（转交、转卖；由一手转至他手）
entries.en: to pass on, transfer; resell from hand to hand

entries.zh: 转流（轮流、轮替）
entries.en: to take turns, alternate from one to another

entries.zh: 搭船过去（乘船渡往）
entries.en: to go across by boat; take passage by ship

entries.zh: 过渡（渡水而过；摆渡）
entries.en: to cross by ferry or boat
entries.notes: M 栏三音节与 H 两字失对、转写对位混乱，释义依西语"乘船前往"与汉字"过渡"

entries.zh: 载过头（载运而过；西语对文作"线过水"）
entries.en: to carry across; (Spanish gloss) to pass the thread through the water
entries.notes: 西语"pasar el hilo por el agua"（线过水）与汉字"载过头"义合曲折，或涉缫丝/穿引语境

entries.zh: 针鼻过去（线穿过针鼻、穿针）
entries.en: to pass the thread through the needle's eye; thread a needle

entries.zh: 透过（穿透、钻透）
entries.en: to bore through, pass through (as an auger)
